stem:
Calculate the molar mass of the following:
(i) \(\text{H}_2\text{O}\)

Calculate the molar mass of the following:
(ii) \(\text{CO}_2\)

Calculate the molar mass of the following:
(iii) \(\text{CH}_4\)
Calculate the mass per cent of different elements present in sodium sulphate \(\left(\text{Na}_2\text{SO}_4\right)\).
Determine the empirical formula of an oxide of iron, which has 69.9% iron and 30.1% dioxygen by mass.

Calculate the amount of carbon dioxide that could be produced when
(i) 1 mole of carbon is burnt in air.

Calculate the amount of carbon dioxide that could be produced when
(ii) 1 mole of carbon is burnt in \(16\,\text{g}\) of dioxygen.

Calculate the amount of carbon dioxide that could be produced when
(iii) 2 moles of carbon are burnt in \(16\,\text{g}\) of dioxygen.

Calculate the mass of sodium acetate \(\left(\text{CH}_3\text{COONa}\right)\) required to make \(500\,\text{mL}\) of \(0.375\) molar aqueous solution. Molar mass of sodium acetate is \(82.0245\,\text{g mol}^{-1}\).
Calculate the concentration of nitric acid in moles per litre in a sample which has a density, \(1.41\,\text{g mL}^{-1}\) and the mass per cent of nitric acid in it being 69%.
How much copper can be obtained from \(100\,\text{g}\) of copper sulphate \(\left(\text{CuSO}_4\right)\)?
Determine the molecular formula of an oxide of iron, in which the mass per cent of iron and oxygen are 69.9 and 30.1, respectively.

Calculate the atomic mass (average) of chlorine using the following data:

| | % Natural Abundance | Molar Mass |
|---|---|---|
| \(^{35}\text{Cl}\) | 75.77 | 34.9689 |
| \(^{37}\text{Cl}\) | 24.23 | 36.9659 |

In three moles of ethane \(\left(\text{C}_2\text{H}_6\right)\), calculate the following:
(i) Number of moles of carbon atoms.

In three moles of ethane \(\left(\text{C}_2\text{H}_6\right)\), calculate the following:
(ii) Number of moles of hydrogen atoms.

In three moles of ethane \(\left(\text{C}_2\text{H}_6\right)\), calculate the following:
(iii) Number of molecules of ethane.

What is the concentration of sugar \(\left(\text{C}_{12}\text{H}_{22}\text{O}_{11}\right)\) in \(\text{mol L}^{-1}\) if its \(20\,\text{g}\) are dissolved in enough water to make a final volume up to \(2\,\text{L}\)?
If the density of methanol is \(0.793\,\text{kg L}^{-1}\), what is its volume needed for making \(2.5\,\text{L}\) of its \(0.25\,\text{M}\) solution?

subtopic: Properties of Matter and Their Measurement

Pressure is determined as force per unit area of the surface. The SI unit of pressure, pascal is as shown below:

\(1\,\text{Pa} = 1\,\text{N m}^{-2}\)

If mass of air at sea level is \(1034\,\text{g cm}^{-2}\), calculate the pressure in pascal.

(ii) Determine the molality of chloroform in the water sample.

The following data are obtained when dinitrogen and dioxygen react together to form different compounds:

| | Mass of dinitrogen | Mass of dioxygen |
|---|---|---|
| (i) | \(14\,\text{g}\) | \(16\,\text{g}\) |
| (ii) | \(14\,\text{g}\) | \(32\,\text{g}\) |
| (iii) | \(28\,\text{g}\) | \(32\,\text{g}\) |
| (iv) | \(28\,\text{g}\) | \(80\,\text{g}\) |

(a) Which law of chemical combination is obeyed by the above experimental data? Give its statement.

Dinitrogen and dihydrogen react with each other to produce ammonia according to the following chemical equation:

\(\text{N}_2(g) + \text{H}_2(g) \rightarrow 2\text{NH}_3(g)\)

(i) Calculate the mass of ammonia produced if \(2.00 \times 10^{3}\,\text{g}\) dinitrogen reacts with \(1.00 \times 10^{3}\,\text{g}\) of dihydrogen.
(ii) Will any of the two reactants remain unreacted?
(iii) If yes, which one and what would be its mass?

A welding fuel gas contains carbon and hydrogen only. Burning a small sample of it in oxygen gives \(3.38\,\text{g}\) carbon dioxide, \(0.690\,\text{g}\) of water and no other products. A volume of \(10.0\,\text{L}\) (measured at STP) of this welding gas is found to weigh \(11.6\,\text{g}\). Calculate (i) empirical formula, (ii) molar mass of the gas, and (iii) molecular formula.

Calcium carbonate reacts with aqueous HCl to give \(\text{CaCl}_2\) and \(\text{CO}_2\) according to the reaction, \(\text{CaCO}_3(s) + 2\,\text{HCl}(aq) \rightarrow \text{CaCl}_2(aq) + \text{CO}_2(g) + \text{H}_2\text{O}(l)\)

What mass of \(\text{CaCO}_3\) is required to react completely with \(25\,\text{mL}\) of \(0.75\,\text{M}\) HCl?

Chlorine is prepared in the laboratory by treating manganese dioxide \(\left(\text{MnO}_2\right)\) with aqueous hydrochloric acid according to the reaction

\(4\,\text{HCl}(aq) + \text{MnO}_2(s) \rightarrow 2\text{H}_2\text{O}(l) + \text{MnCl}_2(aq) + \text{Cl}_2(g)\)

How many grams of HCl react with \(5.0\,\text{g}\) of manganese dioxide?
